name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2017: Atrial Fibrillation Classification from a Short Single Lead ECG
description: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2017 dataset is a standard benchmark designed to stimulate algorithms that distinguish atrial fibrillation (AF) from normal sinus rhythm, other cardiac arrhythmias, and noisy signals using short single-lead ECG recordings. Captured with AliveCor KardiaMobile handheld recorders, the dataset consists of 8,528 single-lead ECG recordings sampled at 300 Hz with lengths varying between 9 and 61 seconds. Expert-annotated reference labels categorize each recording into four mutually exclusive classes: Normal sinus rhythm (5,154), Atrial Fibrillation (771), Other rhythm (2,557), and Noisy recording (46).
